token.name: Porter
token.text: No Store value. Vanishes when Removed.

cards.name: The River Merchant
cards.text: Whenever you Buy or Trade, gain 1 Worth. Once per turn after you Sell: List without using your Store action.
cards.flavor: The river does not keep what it can sell.

cards.name: Dock Runner
cards.text: When this enters the Field, you may Sell a card from your hand.

cards.name: Tally Clerk
cards.text: Once per turn: when you Buy, draw a card.
cards.flavor: He writes the name before you finish saying it.

cards.name: Bargeman
cards.text: When this Presses, you may pay 1 Worth: this gets +2 Strike this Press.
cards.flavor: The pole is also a bill.

cards.name: Ferry Kid
cards.text: The first time a Store card would be Rowed each turn, you may put it into your hand instead. If you do, pay 1 Worth.

cards.name: Purse Cutter
cards.text: When this Presses an Icon, that player loses 1 Worth and you gain 1 Worth.

cards.name: Customs Sergeant
cards.text: Toll 1. Opponents pay 1 more Worth to Buy.
cards.flavor: The stamp is heavier than the crate.

cards.name: Stall Auntie
cards.text: When you Sell, heal 1 Health on your Icon.

cards.name: Ledger Boy
cards.text: When you List or Row, make a Porter token (Companion token, Striker, S 1 G 0 H 1).

cards.name: Market Crier
cards.text: When this enters, you may Row. If you do, that Row does not count as your Store action and costs 0 Worth.

cards.name: Barge Captain
cards.text: Once per turn: when you Buy a Companion, you may put it onto the Field instead of your hand or deck.

cards.name: Coin Nun
cards.text: Once per turn: when you gain Worth, heal 1 Health on your Icon.
cards.flavor: She blesses the count, not the soul.

cards.name: Debt Collector
cards.text: This has +2 Strike if an opponent has 0 Worth.
cards.flavor: Empty pockets still make a sound.

cards.name: Quay Master
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if the Store has 4 or more cards, gain 2 Worth.

cards.name: Silent Partner
cards.text: Closed. You may play this from the Store by paying its Will. It does not use your Store action.
cards.flavor: The name on the paper is never his.

cards.name: Copper Scales
cards.text: Once per turn: the next Trade you make this turn ignores Worth difference of 2 or less.
cards.flavor: Close enough is a kind of honest.

cards.name: Invoice Press
cards.text: When you Sell, gain 1 extra Worth.

cards.name: Row Hook
cards.text: Row costs 1 Worth instead of 2.
cards.flavor: The river turns if you pull.

cards.name: Lockbox
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Worth.
cards.flavor: It clicks. That is the whole prayer.

cards.name: Merchant's Barge
cards.text: Once per turn: you may Buy a card with Store Worth 2 or less without using your Store action.
cards.flavor: The hold was already paid for.

cards.name: Black Ledger
cards.text: Once per turn: look at the Store. You may Trade with a card there from the top of your deck instead of your hand.
cards.flavor: The books remember what the hand forgets.

cards.name: Fair Weight
cards.text: Your first Buy each turn costs 1 less Worth (min 0).
cards.flavor: A thumb on the scale, kindly.

cards.name: Price Tag
cards.text: Attach to a Companion you control. You may Sell the host from the Field as your Store action. If you do, make a Porter token.

cards.name: Silent Handshake
cards.text: Attach to your Icon. The first Buy you make each turn costs 1 less Worth (min 0).

cards.name: Debt Mark
cards.text: Attach to an opponent's Icon. After that player Buys, they lose 1 Worth.
cards.flavor: Interest is a kind of breathing.

cards.name: Porter's Knot
cards.text: Attach to a Companion. Once per turn: when you Trade, ready the host.
cards.flavor: Tied to the work, not the wage.

cards.name: Hard Bargain
cards.text: Buy target Store card. Pay 1 less Worth (min 0). This does not use your Store action.

cards.name: Dump Stock
cards.text: Sell a card from your hand. Gain 2 Worth instead of 1.

cards.name: Corner the River
cards.text: Row. Then you may Buy one card from the new river at −1 Worth (min 0).

cards.name: Open the Hold
cards.text: Look at the top 4 of the Supply. Put two into the Store and the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: False Weight
cards.text: The next Store action an opponent takes this turn must be Keep.

cards.name: Invoice Due
cards.text: Target player loses 3 Worth. You gain that much.

cards.name: Buyout
cards.text: Buy any number of Store cards. Pay their Worth total. This uses your Store action.
cards.flavor: The whole river, in one breath.

cards.name: The Quay
cards.text: This turn, your first Buy costs 1 less Worth (min 0).

cards.name: Counting House
cards.text: This turn, when you Sell, draw a card.

cards.name: Bargemen's Dock
cards.text: Make a Porter token. It cannot Press this turn.

cards.name: Night Market
cards.text: This turn you may List once without using your Store action.

cards.name: Weigh Station
cards.text: This turn, the first time you Trade, gain 1 Worth.
